c74object.name: evi_damp
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Onepole pass/shelf damping filters with simultaneous outputs
c74object.description:
evi_damp is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_damp.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_rcfilters.genexpr, evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_damp is also available in MSP as: evi.damp~.
Two very efficient damping filters in series. A lowpass/highshelf filter (left outlet) and a highpass/lowshelf filter (right outlet). The frequency and damping inlets control both filters simultaneously for high level attenuation control. Useful for damping in reverbs and other situations. With the 'damp' inlet at 0.71..0.99 the first lowpass outlet is similar to MSP [onepole~] (depending on Hz).

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min 1 @max samplerate*0.5. The center frequency around which the filters damp the input signal.

geninlet.name: damp
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @min 0 @max 1 @default 0.75. The amount of damping. A special normalised control: 0 = the filters are bypassed, 1 = the left filter is lowpassed and the right filter is highpassed. Between 0..1 the filters are attenuating shelves.

attribute.name: smoothdamp
attribute.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the damping input control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.

attribute.name: smoothfreq
attribute.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the frequency input control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
